title: Ella, the Animal Shelter, and YOU!

roster.name: Ella
roster.role: A girl who loves dogs and volunteers at her local animal shelter in various ways.

roster.name: Shelter dog
roster.role: Dogs living at the animal shelter that Ella volunteers with and helps find homes.
visual_mentions: Dogs with big bushy tails and dogs with little stubby tails
Dogs with floppy ears and dogs with pointy ears
Poodles, boxers, corgis, labs, dachshunds, huskies, beagles, Dobermans, terriers, dalmatians, bulldogs, pugs

roster.name: Ella's family member
roster.role: Family members who accompany Ella on Doggie Day Out activities with shelter dogs.

roster.name: Adoption event visitor
roster.role: People who attend adoption events where Ella tells them about the dogs and shows off their tricks.

roster.name: Coffee shop worker
roster.role: Staff at the coffee shop where Ella gets pup cups during Doggie Day Out.

roster.name: Second shelter dog
roster.role: Another distinct shelter dog to show variety in breeds and appearances at the shelter.
visual_mentions: Different breed characteristics from the variety mentioned: small/big, fluffy/short-haired, floppy/pointy ears, bushy/stubby tails
